rsao.note: bench (Axiom018, button on a mux slot, 2026-10-23): the lone 0x99 + 9-byte read fails with an I2C hardware timeout and the button drops off the bus for about 1.1 s, then is found and identified again; devices on other slots and the main bus are unaffected (the mux isolates the slot, the master times out after about 1.6 ms). Source: the read handler doesn't check the register pointer, so from 0x99 the length wraps to 65415 and the handler loops inside the I2C interrupt, holding the clock (Qwiic_Button e89a82f interrupts.ino 76-91). No setting changes. Its default address 0x6F is excluded from RSAO addressing
